subject: Request: secure viewer access + short exec summary under NDA
message_1_subject: Initial request: temporary access to pen-test findings / exec summary under NDA
message_1_body:
Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this. We're in the final stages of our vendor review for a major contract and need to validate your remediation posture quickly. Can Redwood provide: 

- A short (1-2 page) executive summary of the most recent penetration test that omits low-level PoC details but lists severity buckets and remediation status; and
- Temporary, view-only access to the full penetration-test evidence via a secure viewer (no download, watermarked, session logs retained) for up to one week for our security team.

We're happy to sign an NDA/addendum — attached is our standard SIG evidence request form for context. Two clarifications: we need logs retained for 90 days for the audit trail, and we cannot accept any files that include customer data.

Please let us know if Redwood has standard redaction rules or a checklist we should follow. If it helps, Jordan Price (copied) will be the technical reviewer on our side.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Security, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

Attachment: SIG-v3-request-form.pdf
message_2_cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme-corp.com>
message_2_subject: Re: Initial request: temporary access to pen-test findings / exec summary under NDA
message_2_body:
Samira / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can accommodate a redacted executive summary plus a one-week secure viewer session under the conditions you mentioned. A few quick items so we align on scope: 

1) Redaction boundary: our usual practice is to remove exploit PoCs, internal hostnames, and code snippets while keeping severity, affected component descriptions, and remediation status. Is that acceptable?
2) Viewer controls: we'll provide view-only, watermark by email, session recording, and IP-blocking if needed. We do not allow downloads or copy/paste from the viewer.
3) Log retention: we can retain viewer access logs for 90 days as requested; please confirm any additional compliance requirements.

Next steps from our side: Legal will prepare a short NDA addendum that specifically permits the viewer session and defines redaction liability. Jonas (security ops) will prepare the redaction checklist and a proposed redacted exec summary. I'll aim to share the redacted exec summary for review by EOD Monday.

Action: Jordan, can you confirm the list of reviewers who need access? Samira, we'll upload files to a share link and send the viewer invite once the NDA addendum is signed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Internal note: tag this as time-sensitive for renewal; coordinate with Legal (Laura) for NDA addendum.

Attachment: (none yet)
message_3_subject: Re: Initial request: temporary access to pen-test findings / exec summary under NDA
message_3_body:
Kimberly —

Thanks, this is helpful. Acme Legal can sign a short NDA addendum (DocuSign link below). A couple of conditions to confirm before we sign: 

- Viewer session must be view-only, with visible watermark (recipient email + timestamp) and disabled copy/download.
- Redwood must provide session logs (viewer access events and IPs) retained for 90 days.
- Redaction boundary: we accept a redacted exec summary that lists severity, impacted subsystems, and remediation status. We do not require PoC or exploit steps.

One additional ask: for auditability, please include a simple redaction manifest (file that lists what types of content were removed) so our auditors can verify the nature of the redaction without seeing the redacted content. That manifest can be limited (e.g., "removed: exploit code, internal hostnames, API keys").

I'll route the DocuSign NDA addendum to Kimberly and Laura; Jordan, please confirm the reviewer list (emails) so Kimberly can watermark correctly.

Regards,
Priyanka Desai
Counsel, Acme Corp
legal@acme-corp.com

message_4_body:
Thanks Priyanka — we agree to the conditions. Summary of what we'll deliver and timing: 

- Redaction manifest (high level): will state removed classes (exploit steps, customer data, hostnames, screenshots with PII).
- Redacted executive summary (PDF): one page summary + remediation table (severity, component, current status). Expected delivery: 2027-05-23 23:59 UTC.
- Secure viewer invite (one-week view-only): we'll send the viewer link and unique watermarked access on 2027-05-24 in the morning Pacific. Viewer logs retained for 90 days.

Redaction checklist (internal): Jonas will run the automated scrubbing, then Laura will do a legal spot-check. Attached is the checklist we'll use for this exchange.

Jordan — please reply with the final reviewer emails (or confirm you and Samira only).

I'll prepare the DocuSign NDA addendum and send for signature within the hour; once signed we'll publish the viewer invite.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
